idea-plugin.name: CIVA Keymap
idea-plugin.description: Adds the MacBook Pro DE keymap: a macOS keymap for MacBook Pro keyboards with German (T1) layout, avoiding shortcuts that are physically unpressable there (keys like / = ; ' ` [ ] exist only as Shift/Option chords on the German layout, and there is no numpad or Insert key). After installing, select MacBook Pro DE under Settings → Keymap.
